def f(I):
    H=len(I); W=len(I[0])
    vals={v:[r for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==v]}
    # background = most common color
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for row in I for v in row)
    bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    nonbg=[v for v,_ in cnt.items() if v!=bg]
    mn_r=min(r for r,row in enumerate(I) if any(v!=bg for v in row))
    mn_c=min(c for c in range(W) if any(I[r][c]!=bg for r in range(H)))
    A=(H-mn_r)%H; B=(W-mn_c)%W
    fill=max(nonbg,key=lambda v: sum(1 for row in I for x in row if x==v))
    Oh,Ow=2*H,2*W
    O=[[fill]*Ow for _ in range(Oh)]
    for r in range(Oh):
        for c in range(Ow):
            rr,cc=(r+A)%H,(c+B)%W
            O[r][c]= I[rr][cc] if I[rr][cc]!=bg else fill
    return O
